title: Rebake Rule Pack
description: Schema for a single validation rule pack consumed by Rebake's IFC compliance validator.

schema_version.description: Pack-format schema version. v1 is the only supported value today; future revisions bump this and update the loader.

id.description: Stable machine identifier. Used in warning citations as `pack_id::rule_id`. Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens only.

version.description: Semver of this pack's content. Bump on any rule change so consumers can pin known-good versions.

name.description: Human-readable display name for Rebake's loaded-packs list.

description.description: Optional longer description of what this pack covers and why.

category.description: Primary grouping axis for Rebake's validation panel. Every warning that rules in this pack fire inherits this category. Open vocabulary — common values: 'ifc', 'building-code', 'sustainability', 'structural', 'accessibility'. Missing or unspecified is legal for back-compat with v1.0 packs; consumers default to 'ifc' in that case.

allowlist.description: One entry per element kind. Each entry says which IFC entity class strings are accepted on elements of that kind.

applies_to.description: Rebake element kind this allowlist row governs.

allowed.description: IFC 4.3 entity class names accepted for this element kind. Must start with `Ifc` followed by PascalCase.
